allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Swiggy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated December 13, 2025, titled "Swiggy successfully completes INR 10,000 Crore Qualified Institutions Placement".

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Swiggy Limited has informed the Exchange about the allotment of 26,66,66,663 Equity shares pursuant to Qualified Institutional Placement at the Investment & Allotment Committee meeting held on Saturday, December 13, 2025
